pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 7.f4 h6
pages.notes: The overview called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 4 had ...g5 with the bishop still on g5 and recaptured on f6 with the g-pawn instead of the usual ...Qxf6. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 7.f4 Nbd7 8.Qe2 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...g5 with White's bishop on g5; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Reworded both; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 7.f4 Nbd7 8.Qf3 Qc7 9.O-O-O b5 10.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bxe6 from a d3-bishop that cannot reach e6. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 7.f4 Nc6 8.Nxc6
pages.notes: The overview said Nxc6 doubles Black's pawns and gives Black the two bishops; neither is true after ...bxc6. Plan 3 used a c6-pawn before Black has recaptured. Rewrote the overview and plans 3 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 7.f4 Qc7 8.Qf3 b5 9.Bxf6
pages.notes: The overview called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 3 named d5 as a move. Rewrote the overview and plan 3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Polugaevsky, 10.exf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black recapture on f6 with the g-pawn and missed the main 10...Qe5+ and ...Qxg5; plan 3 named d5 as a move. Rewrote both.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Polugaevsky, 10.exf6 Qe5+ 11.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Qxg2 with the queen on e5, missing 11...Qxg5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Polugaevsky, 10.exf6 Qe5+ 11.Be2 Qxg5 12.Qd3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had an h3-f3 rook route. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Poisoned Pawn, 8.Bxf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 and the overview had White exploit the dark squares after giving up the dark-squared bishop (reviewer); plan 2 called the half-open g-file open. Rewrote the overview and plans 1 and 2 around the light squares f5, h5 and d5.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Poisoned Pawn, 8.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a3 and b4 against the b6-queen; plan 2 pressured a d4-pawn that does not exist; plan 3 had a c1-e2 route. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling in the overview.
